name: Closing lockup with CTA pill
looks: On a flat warm-gradient ground, the brand's triangular mark and wordmark settle together, a short tagline fades in underneath, and a small rounded CTA button arrives last and holds, closing the film on a calm, static card.
build: Mark and wordmark arrive together (y: 10px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1, power2.out, ~350ms). Tagline fades in 180ms later, no motion beyond opacity. CTA pill lands last with a small scale overshoot (0.95 -> 1.02 -> 1).
sound: A soft low swell fading out under the hold, no further hits once the CTA pill lands.
prompt: Close on a flat, softly gradient brand-colour card: settle the mark and wordmark together, fade in a short tagline underneath, then land a small CTA pill last with a touch of overshoot, holding there as the film ends.
